responsibility: This implementation provides mc’s low-level dynamic array of ADDRESS values, backing the abstract Index type with reallocatable storage, explicit low/high bounds, element deletion by compaction, membership tests, and optional internal debugging checks. It is the concrete storage engine used by higher-level modules such as scope stacks, module universes, and fragment lists when they need indexed rather than tree-based or linked-list-based collections.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file is the concrete implementation for the Indexing stem: it defines the internal Index record and realizes resizing, bounds checks, memmove-based deletion, and debug tracking, whereas the same-named .def file only publishes the abstract API.
